name: Slayers 2
summary: Free Spins, Wen and more for Slayers 2 (also called Project Slayers 2), the Demon Slayer-inspired open-world RPG by Ouw Productions.
about:
Slayers 2 is a free open-world action RPG on Roblox, inspired by Demon Slayer and made by Ouw Productions. It's the sequel to Project Slayers.

You pick one of two paths. Slayers learn Breathing Styles and work toward Final Selection. Demons serve Muzan and unlock Blood Demon Arts. Your clan, rolled with spins, shapes your skills and stats on either path.
redeemSteps: Join the Ouw Productions group on Roblox. The game checks your membership for you.
On the main menu, find the code list and the "Enter a code" box at the bottom.
Type or paste a code and press Enter. Redeemed codes turn green and get crossed out.

troubleshooting.a: Join Ouw Productions, then restart the game. It checks when you join.
Codes are case-sensitive, so use the Copy button.
Each code works once per account.
The code has probably expired. Check back after the next update.

faq.q: Where do you enter codes in Slayers 2?
faq.a: On the main menu, not in the world. The code list sits above an "Enter a code" box at the bottom of the screen, as shown in the screenshot on this page. Type the code and press Enter.

faq.q: How do I know if a code is still live?
faq.a: The game itself shows a countdown next to each code in that menu, which is where the expiry dates on this page come from. If a code is gone from the in-game list, it's dead.

faq.q: Do I have to join the group?
faq.a: Yes, join Ouw Productions on Roblox first, then fully close and reopen the game. The game checks your membership itself, and codes fail until it sees you in the group.
Enter them exactly as listed. The in-game list shows them in capitals, and the Copy button on this page avoids typos.

faq.q: Is this the same as Project Slayers 2?
faq.a: Yes. The Roblox page calls it Slayers 2 and the in-game logo says Project Slayers 2, so both names refer to this game.

faq.q: Do codes carry over from the first Project Slayers?
faq.a: No. Slayers 2 has its own codes, and your levels, gear and Wen from the first game don't transfer either.
